glosses: country, land (a set region of land having particular human occupation or agreed limits)

examples.en: What do you know about my country?

examples.text: ¿Qué lengua se habla en tu país?
examples.en: What language do they speak in your country?

examples.text: Ambos países están en paz ahora.
examples.en: Both countries are now at peace.

examples.text: ¿Cuándo vas a volver a tu país?
examples.en: When are you going back to your own country?

examples.text: Me gusta tener amigos en todos los países.
examples.en: I like having friends in every country.
